items.title: Coherent Is the Real Winner of Huang’s Return. Nvidia Paid $2 Billion for Its Stock
items.summary: Key TakeawaysCoherent shares jumped 15% after Nvidia’s board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, a week after Coherent fell 9% on Nvidia’s leadership turmoil. Nvidia paid $2 billion for Coherent stock in March and is the lead customer for the co-packaged optics Coherent expects to start selling in the December 2026 quarter.
